title: Ciphertext local turning-point position prior
rationale: This lane is preregistered before scoring any new source-backed observations and does not search public known-plaintext anchors, candidate key material, or anchor-derived additive fragments. The discovery rule uses only K4 ciphertext positions encoded in the Kryptos alphabet and asks whether future independently sourced non-anchor position observations concentrate at local index turning points more than seeded null controls.
prediction_target: Future independently sourced non-anchor K4 position observations should be enriched at positions selected by a predeclared local turning-point or high-curvature rule over the ciphertext index sequence.
discovery_inputs: K4 ciphertext letters only, mapped to Kryptos alphabet indexes.
Predeclared local-turning-point rule using neighboring ciphertext index differences; no known plaintext, additive fragment values, candidate words, or previously scored observation positions.
evaluation_inputs: A future source-backed observation file containing independently justified one-based non-anchor K4 positions or a documented position-selection rule.
The existing public anchor fragments are excluded as primary evidence and may only appear in negative-control or provenance summaries.
controls: seeded position-shuffle null baseline over the same number of observed non-anchor positions
best-of-rule multiple-comparison control if more than one turning-point threshold or curvature variant is emitted
archive validation requiring the preregistration, prediction artifact, source-backed observation file, command metadata, and non-promotion caveat
